mainCiGreen.evidence: GitHub Actions main run #97 passed sandbox source, canonical PostgreSQL, and hardened PostgreSQL jobs after operational-readiness merge.

canonicalPostgres.evidence: Canonical migrations, checksum idempotency, fail-closed control, audit immutability, ledger immutability, balanced journals, tests, and builds run against PostgreSQL 16.

productionPostgresMajorParity.evidence: GitHub Actions run #98 passed canonical and hardened rollback paths on PostgreSQL 16 and PostgreSQL 18; production Railway Postgres is major version 18.

workerReconciliationParity.evidence: Canonical retry/backoff/dead-letter and stale reconciliation escalation are integration-tested against PostgreSQL 16.

serviceTopology.evidence: Independent API, worker, and reconciliation entrypoints build in CI.

healthcheckCompatibility.evidence: Canonical API exposes /ready and /healthz; worker and reconciliation expose /health and /healthz.

authContractParity.evidence: Exact OAuth/shared contract parity and API compatibility gates run in CI.

deviceTrustOtpParity.evidence: Canonical security contract gates and security unit tests pass; device/session/OTP ownership and purpose separation remain enforced.

rollbackRunbook.evidence: docs/runbooks/canonical-backend-cutover.md defines service-by-service rollback to the hardened artifact.

incidentResponseRunbook.evidence: docs/runbooks/incident-response.md defines severity, containment, evidence preservation, and recovery.

observabilityBaseline.evidence: Canonical services expose sanitized health state and structured operational events/counters for dispatch and reconciliation.

backupRecoveryPoint.evidence: A PostgreSQL volume exists, but an exact recent recoverable backup/PITR recovery point has not been independently verified through the available read-only tools.

restoreVerification.evidence: No disposable restore test has yet proven recovery from the production backup source.

cutover.reason: Do not switch backend Dockerfiles/artifact sources until backupRecoveryPoint and restoreVerification are verified.
